## Cogrunt (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
N Small fey  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +12  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 38 (7d6+14)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +8, **Will** +7  
**DR** 5/cold iron; SR 14  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** hand cannon +7 (1d6)  
**Ranged** hand cannon +7 (1d6/x3)  
**Special Attacks** disassemble (DC 15), speedy sabotage, tinker  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 7th; concentration +9)  


At will—mending  

1/day—make whole  



**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 15, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Deft Hands, Field Repair, Sabotage Specialist, Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Appraise +9, Craft (alchemy, firearms, mechanical) +12, Disable Device +20, Knowledge (engineering) +13, Perception +12, Stealth +17; Racial Modifiers +8 Disable Device, +4 Knowledge (engineering)  
**Languages** Common, Gnome, Undercommon  


**Special Abilities**


**Disassemble (Ex)** As a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity, a cogrunt can touch a non-magical object no more than one size category larger than itself, forcing either it or its wielder to attempt a DC 15 Reflex saving throw. On a failed save, the object is reduced to 1 hit point and gains the broken condition. Using this ability on an already broken object has no effect. The save DC is Intelligence-based.  

**Tinker (Ex)** Once per day, as a full-round action that provokes an attack of opportunity, a cogrunt can tinker with a construct, choosing to either repair it or tamper with it. A repaired construct regains 3d10 hit points. A construct that is tampered with must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be affected as if it failed a save against the sabotage construct spell at CL 7th. The save DC is Intelligence-based.  

**Speedy Sabotage (Ex)** When using the Disable Device skill, cogrunts treat all devices as being one category simpler for the purposes of determining how long it takes to use the skill. Thus, difficult devices count as tricky, tricky devices count as simple, and simple devices can be dismantled as a free action.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or team (3–10)  
**Treasure** standard (hand cannon, masterwork artisan tools, other treasure)
